mapper.select: select a.id,area_code,area_name,warehouse_id ,warehouse_code,warehouse_name,area_type,a.status,a.create_time,a.update_time from wms_area a inner join wms_warehouse w on a.warehouse_id = w.id where a.status = 1 order by id limit #{start},10

select a.id,area_code,area_name,warehouse_id,warehouse_code,warehouse_name,area_type,a.status,a.create_time,a.update_time from wms_area a inner join wms_warehouse w on a.warehouse_id = w.id where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and a.status = 1 order by id limit #{start},10

select area_code,area_name,warehouse_id,warehouse_code,warehouse_name,area_type,a.status,a.create_time,a.update_time from wms_area a inner join wms_warehouse w on warehouse_id = w.id where area_code =#{areaCode} and a.status = 1
mapper.update: update wms_area set status = 0 where area_code = #{areaCode}
mapper.select: select id from wms_warehouse where warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode}
